items: Tackle multitasking with ease thanks to the latest 12th Gen Intel N150 Processor (4 cores, 4 threads, up to 3.6GHz). Combined with fast 16GB LPDDR5 RAM and a responsive 512GB SSD (which supports expansion via an M.2 2280 slot up to 1TB), this mini laptop ensures swift app launches, smooth web browsing, and effortless handling of your daily tasks.

Experience the flexibility of a 360° flip-and-fold design that effortlessly switches between laptop, tablet, tent, and stand modes . Crafted with a sleek metallic body, this compact and portable laptop is incredibly lightweight at just 0.899kg and thin (11mm at its thinnest part) , making it the perfect travel companion for work and entertainment on the go.

Enjoy stunning clarity on the 10.51-inch FHD+ touchscreen laptop display with a sharp 1920x1200 resolution and a 16:10 aspect ratio for more vertical space . With 100% sRGB color coverage, this convertible laptop delivers a superior visual experience for streaming videos, browsing the web, or casual creative work

Stay connected at high speeds with the latest Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.2 for stable and efficient wireless connections. Equipped with versatile ports including full-function USB-C, you can easily connect to peripherals, transfer data, and charge your device. The efficient processor and well-optimized system contribute to impressive battery life for all-day use.

Work comfortably in any lighting with the backlit keyboard on this Windows 11 laptop. The efficient cooling fan ensures quiet operation and sustained performance during extended use. With a high-quality webcam for video calls and a pre-installed genuine Windows 11 OS, this 2-in-1 laptop is ready to use right out of the box.
